svg.title: Which path to use
svg.desc: Decision guide. No footage in the composition: Remotion with Vulkan and NVENC (P1). Footage that is one rectangular take at a time: layers with dedup. Several takes at once, masks, rotation or blur on the footage: P1. Mostly still frames: dedup helps.
svg.text: From the pilot and the partial quick run (N=1 to 3). Measure your own video with npm run bench:quick.

g.text: Is each take a rectangle on screen (crop, zoom,
punch-in, card) with one take at a time?
B, R: 1.5–4.2× less CPU than P1,
